primitives.name: Defensive Back Coverage Assignment
primitives.verbatim_quote: 64 AMERICAN FOOTBALL due to the policy of breaking wide, are coming directly to his assistance.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: C_{DB} - Defensive Back coverage assignment (dimensionless), N_{wide} - Number of wide receivers receiving direct assistance (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes linear scaling between defensive back assignments and the number of wide receivers requiring coverage assistance.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime where the number of wide receivers exceeds available defensive backs leads to coverage gaps.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI defensive efficiency models using coverage probability metrics P(C|N)
layer2.telemetry: Average yards allowed per pass attempt when defensive backs are outnumbered

primitives.name: Middle Defensive Back Positioning
primitives.verbatim_quote: The only unguarded hole has the middle defensive back directly behind it.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: x_{MDB} - Middle Defensive Back optimal position (meters), x_{hole} - Hole position relative to line of scrimmage (meters), d_{lag} - Lag distance accounting for reaction time (meters)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes the middle defensive back positions himself at a fixed lag distance behind the hole location.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime where reaction time delay d_{lag} exceeds the time to the ball carrier reaching the hole.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSE pursuit curve models with constant speed targets
layer2.telemetry: Time-to-contact metric for middle linebacker to gap

primitives.name: Pre-Scrimmage Line Impact
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is vital, whenever the attack begins to gain ground, that the defensive backs hit the play before it gets beyond the line of scrimmage.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: t_{impact} - Time until impact (seconds), t_{threshold} - Threshold time before ball crosses line of scrimmage (seconds)
primitives.assumptions: Assumes a binary event where impact occurs either before or after the threshold time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime where t_{impact} approaches t_{threshold} from above causes increased expected yardage loss.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI forced fumble and sack probability models conditional on pressure timing
layer2.telemetry: Sack rate as function of pressure arrival window

primitives.name: Quarterback Play Prediction
primitives.verbatim_quote: OUTGUESS THE QUARTERBACK The players must be trained to figure, while on the defense, upon what play the opposing quarterback is about to call.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P_{predict} - Probability of correctly predicting the quarterback's play (dimensionless), QB_{history} - Historical sequence of quarterback decisions (dimensionless)
primitives.assumptions: Models quarterback behavior as a stochastic process conditioned on prior plays.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Regime where prediction accuracy drops below 50% indicates exploitable patterns.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI predictive analytics using Markov decision processes over playbooks
layer2.telemetry: Correct play identification rate vs. random guessing baseline
